segments.description: Designs, develops and commercializes transportation and safety solutions that prevent car accidents by detecting cellular phone RF signals, for vehicle fleets and manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Since inception date, the operation of the Company is conducted through one operating segment, i.e., development of the technology necessary to create a life-saving system that prevents certain uses of cell phones while driving a motor vehicle.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for SaverOne systems sold and installed in fleets and vehicles, through commercial orders and distributors in the aftermarket.
revenueModel.evidence: We are currently offering our solution for commercial deployments only, with an initial, pre-defined period, for evaluating the solution.
